_comment: Fallback grid-region assignment for Layer B projects, used only where the
written by fetch_grid_territory.py) has no row for the county.
Every assignment carries a basis so a reader can tell how much to trust it:
county_override   a county named below, served by a utility whose RTO
membership differs from the rest of its state
state_default     a state that sits wholly or almost wholly in one region
state_split       a state divided between regions; the default is the
larger share and is a guess for any county not listed
The overrides list only counties whose serving utility is unambiguous
(ComEd, Indiana Michigan Power, Duke Energy Kentucky, Dominion North
Carolina, Evergy, Ameren Missouri, Xcel SPS, Entergy Texas, SWEPCO, El Paso
Electric). Counties served by several utilities across a seam are left to
the EIA-861 join rather than guessed here.
Regions: the seven ISO/RTOs by their common names, plus 'Southeast (non-RTO)'
and 'West (non-RTO)' for vertically integrated regions. Western Energy
Imbalance Market participation is not RTO membership and is not recorded.

IL.note: ComEd (northern IL) is PJM; Ameren Illinois is MISO

IN.note: Indiana Michigan Power's counties are PJM; Duke Energy Indiana, AES Indiana, NIPSCO and Vectren are MISO

MI.note: Indiana Michigan Power's southwest Michigan counties are PJM

KY.note: EKPC, Kentucky Power and Duke Energy Kentucky are PJM; LG&E-KU is non-RTO; TVA serves the southwest; Big Rivers is MISO

MO.note: Ameren Missouri is MISO; Evergy and Liberty are SPP; Associated Electric cooperatives are non-RTO

MS.note: Entergy Mississippi and Cooperative Energy are MISO; TVA serves the north; Mississippi Power is non-RTO

ND.note: eastern utilities are MISO; much of the west is SPP

TX.note: the Panhandle (Xcel SPS) is SPP, southeast Texas (Entergy) is MISO, El Paso is West (non-RTO)

NM.note: eastern New Mexico (Xcel SPS) is SPP

AR.note: SWEPCO and OG&E serve western Arkansas in SPP

SD.note: a few eastern cooperatives are MISO
